question: Do recent publicly released sarcoma organoid/tumoroid living-biobank studies include source-authenticated native EMC donors and processed perturbation or phenotype conditions that could support a useful new empirical comparison?
useful_measurement_if_source_passes: A native same-donor or independently compatible measured organoid phenotype/drug response, with actual controls and all conditions, could justify a specific assay-context experiment beyond catalogue membership or published trial/paper summaries. No broad compound ranking or dependency hypothesis selected.
prior_art_rule: Reuse R1–R9 complete native culture/model/QPOP/CIVO/GenPharm/resource gates and native USZ/NCC drug observations. Do not redownload unchanged sources or infer a new finding from recovering their access.
source_route: Finite metadata search exact/historical EMC+organoid/tumoroid, broader sarcoma+organoid/biobank, then at most two genuine newly linked primary/supplement/author-deposit branches coordinated with independent reviewer. No random URL or duplicate failed route.
allowed_fields: primary/deposit titles and genuine source links
all histology/native donor/model identifiers and exact diagnostic confidence
all assay conditions, controls, platform/readout/units/dose-duration schema without response values
processed-data availability, donor/lesion/preparation overlap and handling/treatment
closed: No response/gene matrix cells, RNA outcomes, raw reads/images, expensive analysis or numerical comparison. No private/login/credentials/bypass/spend/outreach/publication/UI. FAP/glycan/HLA/structural/fusion-form/topology denied scopes remain closed.
strongest_alternatives: Broad sarcoma/cartilage site label substituted for EMC
Living biobank or organoid label masks engineered/disputed line or stromal admixture
Technical wells, preparations or repeats treated as independent native donors
Matched exposure, assay units or control conditions absent
Source paper already establishes the only apparent contrast
Culture/growth/format/pharmacology rather than disease-specific phenotype explains any eventual difference
defeat: No authenticated native EMC and suitable public measured conditions, or no useful unanswered contrast beyond source paper/prior decisions: source-specific no-go with actual generic/eligible/pending/unavailable distinctions. No inventory finding or biological absence/exhaustion claim.
numeric_stage_rule: If actual new eligible sources emerge, report identities/condition/schema and finite useful next question immediately; separate exact before-value plan and root review required.
ownership: Owned subtree only; radiotherapy owns cultures/PDX/Jinno2026; fapi_named independent organoid omission/assay source branch; root integrates/pushes. Codex author+committer; original freezes immutable.
